title: Sparsity Regularized and Robust Mean Variance Portfolio Selection Under Ellipsoidal Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.11749v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate mean-variance portfolio selection with an $\ell_0$-penalty to promote sparsity in asset allocations. Uncertainty in the mean return vector is incorporated through an ellipsoidal uncertainty set, yielding a robust sparse optimization framework. We characterize the structure of both local and global minimizers and exploit these properties in the risk minimization and return maximization formulations. Building on this structural insight, we develop a branch-and-bound algorithm tailored to the resulting robust sparse portfolio problems, together with a new pruning rule that can discard exponentially many candidate portfolios in a single step. Extensive computational experiments on real market data, together with comparisons against a mixed-integer second-order cone programming solver, demonstrate the effectiveness and competitiveness of the proposed approach.

translated_title: 椭球不确定性下稀疏正则化的鲁棒均值-方差投资组合选择
translated_abstract: 我们研究了带有ℓ₀惩罚项的均值-方差投资组合选择问题，以促进资产配置的稀疏性。通过椭球不确定性集来刻画平均收益向量的不确定性，从而构建了一个鲁棒稀疏优化框架。我们刻画了局部与全局极小值点的结构，并在风险最小化和收益最大化两种模型中利用了这些性质。基于这一结构性认识，我们针对所得的鲁棒稀疏投资组合问题开发了一种定制的分支定界算法，并提出了一种新的剪枝规则，能够一次性丢弃指数级数量的候选投资组合。在真实市场数据上开展的大量计算实验，以及与混合整数二阶锥规划求解器的对比，证明了所提方法的有效性与竞争力。
tldr: 本文针对椭球不确定性下的稀疏鲁棒均值-方差投资组合选择问题，通过刻画最优解结构设计了一种带新型剪枝规则的分支定界算法，可一步剔除指数级多的候选组合，实验验证了其有效性与竞争力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a tailored branch-and-bound algorithm with a novel pruning rule—capable of discarding exponentially many candidate portfolios in a single step—for solving sparsity-regularized robust mean-variance portfolio selection problems under ellipsoidal uncertainty, with experiments demonstrating its effectiveness and competitiveness.
